bio.title: I'm Chilik. Let's get acquainted
bio.text: I was born and have lived my entire life in my beloved city, Bnei Brak. From a deep-rooted Lithuanian family, I studied at Ponevezh Yeshiva. I love the Haredi world and enjoy hosting you in it – of course with all the heart-warming Jewish food.
paragraphs: I’m Chilik, a Haredi Torah scholar from Bnei Brak. I was born here, grew up here and live this life every day. I studied at Ponevezh, and my family’s roots run deep in this world. My grandfather even founded the first Talmud Torah after the Holocaust. I love Haredi society and its culture, and above all, I love people.

When we meet, I invite you on a short, fascinating journey into Haredi life. Who are we? What is life like from the inside? What lies behind matchmaking, military service or becoming a parent at a young age? I answer honestly and openly, with a little humour along the way.
These encounters are moving for me too: seeing your curiosity and discovery of lives so close by, yet seemingly far away.
And between us? I love bringing in warm cholent, fresh Vizhnitz challah or good gefilte fish. An experience needs flavour.
If you are curious, I’m here to take you on a genuine, funny and especially delicious journey.

streams.desc: We'll learn about the differences between Hasidim and Lithuanians and the fascinating social structure.

shidduch.desc: How do you build a Jewish home? From the meeting in the hotel lobby to the wedding.

architecture.title: Creative Construction

books.desc: Visiting the Jewish book institutions where the written word reigns supreme.

charity.title: Gemachs and Charity
charity.desc: A glimpse into the amazing world of lending pacifiers to charity boxes.

yeshiva.title: Yeshivas and Cheders
yeshiva.desc: We'll experience up close what really happens all day in a yeshiva and how a Haredi child grows up.

bakery.title: Vizhnitz Bakery
bakery.desc: We'll enter the heart of the mythological bakery and see how challah is braided.

volunteering.title: Volunteering and Charity
volunteering.desc: We'll meet the organizations that drive Haredi society - charity as a way of life.

reason1.title: An Insider's Perspective
reason1.desc: My tour is based on deep familiarity with the alleys where I grew up. This is not an external guide, but a rare glimpse into my Haredi life.

reason2.title: Exclusive Tastings
reason2.desc: We'll only visit the best places for Jewish food, spots that are passed along by word of mouth in Bnei Brak. Shhh... keep the secret too.

reason3.title: Bridge Between Worlds
reason3.desc: A tour full of humor and open dialogue. Here, every question is welcomed with a smile.

q1.question: Can a private tour be arranged?
q1.answer: Yes. Contact Chilik to arrange a private group tour, with the date and content agreed in advance.

q2.question: When are upcoming tours and how can I check availability?
q2.answer: Tours usually take place on Thursday evenings. Contact Chilik on WhatsApp, by phone or by email for dates and availability; availability is confirmed personally.

q3.question: How long does the tour last?
q3.answer: The tour usually lasts between two and a half and three hours.

q4.question: What should I wear?
q4.answer: Please wear respectful, modest clothing. If you are unsure about a particular item, ask in advance about the places visited.

q5.question: Can I buy prepared food for Shabbat during the tour?
q5.answer: During the tour, Chilik can recommend places to buy prepared food for Shabbat.

q6.question: What does a culinary tour of Bnei Brak with Chilik include?
q6.answer: The tour combines tastes of Jewish cuisine with stories and an introduction to Haredi life and culture in Bnei Brak, guided by Chilik Rosenberg.

q7.question: How much does the tour cost?
q7.answer: The tour costs ILS 250 per participant. Payment and arrangements are agreed personally with Chilik.

q8.question: Where do we meet and where can I park?
q8.answer: Exact meeting details are provided after the arrangement is confirmed personally. Contact Chilik before arrival to confirm the meeting point, parking and directions.

q9.question: What food will we taste?
q9.answer: The menu section shows examples of Jewish cuisine, including cholent, kugel, fish and chopped liver. Contact Chilik before arranging the tour for details of the tastings.

q10.question: What is the kashrut standard, and are vegetarian or allergy adjustments available?
q10.answer: Contact Chilik before arranging the tour to check the certifications at tour stops and whether tastings can meet your needs. Do not assume every stop can accommodate every dietary restriction.

q11.question: Is the tour suitable for children, strollers or people with walking difficulties?
q11.answer: Contact Chilik before arranging the tour to discuss participant ages and accessibility needs. Check the walking route and access conditions at the places visited in advance.

q12.question: What if I need to cancel or postpone?
q12.answer: Cancellation and postponement conditions are listed in the terms. To change anything, contact Chilik with your arrangement details.

intro.label: Tours and talks with Chilik
paragraphs: You may know about us, but now it is time to taste, discover and experience our world up close, authentically and directly.
This is what I love most: meeting you, opening a door into my world and the Haredi community, and sharing an unforgettable experience.
A personal, honest encounter that is thoughtful, funny and, above all, delicious.

inclusions.title:
An unforgettable cultural
and culinary experience including:
items: Visits to unique and fascinating places
An introduction to Haredi food and culinary culture

lectures.title:
Bringing a team or friends together?
Looking for a fascinating experience?
paragraphs: I come to your company, living room or high school, ready for your questions. The curiosity is palpable.
Then we talk about Haredi life. Who are we, and how do our communities differ? How do matchmaking and attitudes to military service really work? What appears on a screen is not the whole story.
How does an 18-year-old Haredi young man feel ready to become a father? These lives can seem so different.
I love these encounters: listening to your questions, sometimes unspoken, and answering honestly and directly, with a little humour that opens the door to something deeper.
